answer: Because the timing is written down against the vertex challenge, the island audit can replay the nadir history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 242 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1619 identities would post 2265 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
